description: Ventura County (FIPS 06111): Assessor attribute data needs a public records request and a signed public information agreement; the county web hosts block automated clients. NOT VERIFIED. Review record: docs/registry/sources/ca-ventura-assessor.md.

sources.publisher: Ventura County Assessor; Ventura County GIS (GISVentura)
sources.license: None for the free layer (the item's licenseInfo is a disclaimer: maps and data 'are to be used for reference purposes only'). Assessor data: 'make a public records request and fill out a public info agreement contract' (item description). Gate: records request and agreement
sources.redistribution: Not addressed for the layer; the county's Address Points metadata says not for redistribution
sources.notes: Gate: records request, and the Assessor's host assessor.venturacounty.gov and the county GIS host maps.ventura.org answer 403 to automated clients (F5 firewall, robots.txt included). Free file: item e0721a09a7214788be60dc7f0834ea91 'Parcels Monthly' (owner GISVentura, 268,134 parcels, modified 2026-10-05) has only APN, APN10 and centroid lat/lon: no use code, situs or values. The item description itself says assessor attribute data must be requested from the Assessor. What would clear the gate: the Assessor's public records request for the secured roll with use codes and a signed public information agreement; or telephone (805) 654-2181.
